sentences.en: Don't succumb to lunacy too much, tomorrow is your wedding!
sentences.zh: 别太屈服于疯狂了，明天就是你的婚礼!

sentences.en: Endeavor to reach your objectives and do not succumb to failures.
sentences.zh: 努力达成目标，不要因为失败就屈服。

sentences.en: My grandfather succumbed to a terminal cancer this year.
sentences.zh: 我爷爷今年因绝症去世了。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：suc（下面）+cumb（躺）→躺下去不再起来→因…死亡
